audit: InFlite sitewide UI UX and security review

excluded: blokk and block are private repository tools; middleware denies their production paths

design_changes: One generated set of spacing, surface radius and motion tokens across all seven InFlite app stylesheets; foundation tokens for Status, portfolio and fitting
30px cards, 26px groups, 38px sheets, 4/8/12/16/24/32px spacing, shared spring and glide curves
Profile menus recalculate position and available height on window and visual-viewport changes; long names, email addresses, labels and values wrap
Menu keyboard focus skips disabled switches, restores its anchor, and releases the page after dismissal
Small menu travel replaces large scaling; menu backdrop dimming avoids full-screen blur; reduced motion and transparency preserve legibility
Extra title line height prevents descender clipping
Weather saved places are keyboard accessible
Fitting fields and calculated measurements shrink within narrow cards; icon-only mobile controls have accessible names; light secondary text and red buttons meet contrast checks
Solid-surface fallbacks for Status and portfolio when reduced transparency is requested

fixed.finding: Malformed numeric HTML entities could throw while parsing external Markets names or previews
fixed.change: Validate Unicode code points, replace invalid values and reject surrogate code points

fixed.finding: Push fetches could follow redirects after validating the original endpoint
fixed.change: Both push implementations use manual redirects and leave provider response bodies and endpoint-bearing errors out of logs

fixed.finding: Mail writes depended on custom-header and fetch-metadata gates without an explicit exact Origin check
fixed.change: Require Mail, the configured hub, or the narrowly scoped Account origin for mutations; reject absent, opaque and lookalike origins

fixed.finding: Repository-only files should not be exposed as public assets
fixed.change: Exclude documentation, tests, lockfiles and source maps from assets; deny decoded repository paths before reaching ASSETS

fixed.finding: Vendored jsPDF 2.5.1 had published advisories, outside the main package inventory
fixed.change: Replace with npm-integrity-verified jsPDF 4.2.1, version the load URL and refresh the fitting offline cache; verify real raster PDF export

fixed.finding: Status and fitting read some JSON bodies before enforcing size limits
fixed.change: Use stream-bounded readers: 8KiB for subscriptions and fitting settings/login; 32KB for authenticated Status reports/deploy notices

fixed.finding: Malformed Google settings JSON could clear an existing client ID; JSON null could cause a login exception
fixed.change: Validate input before changing settings and return a client error for malformed or unsupported login data

fixed.finding: Public Status subscriptions accepted writes without an explicit origin check
fixed.change: Require an exact same-origin POST before reading subscription bodies

fixed.finding: Markets previews accepted reserved internal domain suffixes
fixed.change: Reject localhost, local, internal and home.arpa names on initial and redirected preview requests

fixed.finding: Pinned Wrangler 4.149.0 included undici advisories in development/deployment tooling
fixed.change: Pin Wrangler 4.158.0 in tests, builder fallback, hub helper and deployment workflows; regenerate the dependency lockfile

reviewed_boundaries: Exact origin and source checks for cross-window messages
Mail body sandbox without allow-scripts, message CSP and remote-content isolation
Account freshness/passkey requirements for Mail administration
Session separation, object ownership, parameterized SQL and request/body caps
Redirect validation, allowlisted push endpoints and preview URLs
CSP, HSTS and MIME protections across all eleven public roots

unit.skip_reason: Obsolete pre-framework milestones and the replaced frame stub; current framework cases run instead

today_webkit.skip_reason: The offline interception fixture is Chromium-specific

shared_design_status_fitting.includes: Real fitting login, all fit steps, PDF generation, long menus, resize, keyboard focus and reduced preferences
shared_design_status_fitting.evidence: design-release.log after the final generated CSS

sitewide_layout.notes: Intentional peeking homepage carousel cards are separately classified. Account modal backdrop text is inert background, not overlapping foreground content; a follow-up checked 10 modal/menu screens with zero findings.

Fitness_sheets.includes: Offline image export, online vector maps, Activities, Progress, Rhythm, training and device/settings sheets

hostile_Mail_body_e2e.includes: Sandbox and CSP isolation, no outbound attacker traffic until explicit image loading, exact message scope, forged postMessage refusal, quotes, newsletter zoom, frame heights and worker cache exclusion

limits: Automated browser checks use disposable local accounts and deterministic service fixtures, alongside read-only production header and release checks. They do not enumerate every possible user-data combination.
WebKit automation covers the rendering engine; physical iPhone performance, permission prompts and third-party outages need device/provider observation.
Markets URL restrictions are defense in depth, not a claim of complete DNS-rebinding prevention.
Some compact controls are smaller than 44px but meet the measured 24px target or spacing requirement. Intentionally peeking carousel cards are classified separately from inaccessible overflow.
test_fixture_updates: Model location permission explicitly in saved-place Weather checks; test lazy imports with Save Data and preserve the current Radar fill-header contract
Use a real document load event for reload assertions instead of a same-document history event
Mail write fixtures include the browser Origin header; explicit negative tests still reject missing, opaque and foreign origins
Use the generated local Worker configuration for D1 reads and pass SQL as an argument without shell interpolation
Compare message-frame heights with measured rendered content instead of assuming a fixed minimum newsletter height
